meta.sourceSheet: worksheet 'cards' of the designer spreadsheet (kept outside this repo)
notes: buildCost is derived from the @cost1..@cost6 icon columns, which are authoritative; the sheet's 'Build Cost' text column is lossy.
A suit has THREE starters - Barn (ref 1), Farmstead (ref 2), Notice Board (ref 3) - plus the 18-card deck (refs 4..21). 105 cards total (15 starters + 90 deck).

The only loadable starter is the Notice Board (threshold 5 / wild), which upgrades to 'Special Orders'. The Farmstead is a passive suit-power card (no threshold); the Barn prints an absolute hand size on each face (`handSize`).

Each starter's base row carries a combined 'base\nUpgrade:...' cell; the base face keeps the part before 'Upgrade', and the upgraded face is taken from the separate 'U' row (its own name, 2 VP, and full text).

No card text is ever rewritten here. The sheet is the single source of truth for wording, so the web game and the physical game cannot drift apart on rules text; the tuning overlay carries numbers and flags only. A ruling that changes wording is applied to the sheet first, then re-extracted.
Every card carries `enabled: true`. It is a tuning-overlay flag, not a printed property: switching a card off is how a paired comparison run asks whether the game is better without it.

abilityTrigger is keyword detection over the printed text, not a resolved ruling. needsDesignReview=true means 0 or >1 triggers matched, and those cards are re-read by hand when their handlers are written.

The one STRUCTURAL trigger is `action`: a tier card with printed text but no threshold and no activation type can be neither grown nor sown, so its text fires as a MAIN ACTION instead - taken in place of Draw, Build, Grow, Harvest or Deliver. The sheet prints no prefix for it, which is why it is read off the shape of the card rather than off a keyword.
The Deliver trigger has TWO keys: onDeliver ('When you Deliver...', fires on island claims and balloon moves) and onDeliverIsland ('When you Deliver to the island...', island claims only).

starter.name: Barn
starter.abilityText:
Hand size 5.
When you build a HIVE, sow the top card of any deck onto it.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Barn
upgraded.abilityText:
Hand size 7.
When you build a HIVE, sow the top card of any deck onto it.

starter.name: Farmstead
starter.abilityText:
When you GROW, Draw 1.
Flips free when you have 3 Apiary buildings.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Farmstead
upgraded.abilityText: When you GROW, Draw 1 and you may put 1 card from your hand into your barn.

starter.name: Notice Board
starter.abilityText:
VISITOR: Take £1 from bank
OR GROW one of your buildings.

catalogue.name: The Herb Hive
catalogue.abilityText: Put 1 card from a neighbour's building into your barn, and sow the top card of any deck in its place.

catalogue.name: The Meadow Hive
catalogue.abilityText: GROW another of your buildings without placing a card.

catalogue.name: The Garden Hive
catalogue.abilityText: GROW another of your buildings with a card of any crop.

catalogue.name: The Foraging Hive
catalogue.abilityText: Sow 1 card from your hand onto another of your buildings.

catalogue.name: The Wild Hive
catalogue.abilityText: Put the top card of any deck into a neighbour's barn and take £1 from the bank.

catalogue.name: The Pollinator Trail
catalogue.abilityText: Sow the top card of any deck onto each of your HIVEs.

catalogue.name: The Cross-Pollinator
catalogue.abilityText: Draw 1 for each of your HIVEs.

catalogue.name: The Wax Workshop
catalogue.abilityText: Put 1 card from each of your HIVEs into your barn.

catalogue.name: The Honey Hut
catalogue.abilityText: GROW 2 of your other buildings without placing a card.

catalogue.name: The Queen's Hive
catalogue.abilityText: Sow the top card of each deck onto your buildings.

catalogue.name: The Honeycomb Tower
catalogue.abilityText: Sow the top card of any deck onto a neighbour's building. Take £1 from the bank for each of your HIVEs.

catalogue.name: The Royal Apiary
catalogue.abilityText: Put the top card of each deck into any neighbour's barn. Take £2 from the bank for each.

catalogue.name: The Beekeeper's Veil
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever you place a card that brings a building's stack to 2 cards, Draw 1.

catalogue.name: The Smoke Pot
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever you VISIT a neighbour, sow the top card of any deck onto one of your buildings.

catalogue.name: Helping Hand
catalogue.abilityText: When you VISIT a neighbour, you may place a second card on their Notice Board and take its action again.

catalogue.name: The Honey Hall
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 3 VP for each non-Apiary building you have built.

catalogue.name: The Apiarist's Guild
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 2 VP for each HIVE you have built.

catalogue.name: The Wax Hall
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 1 VP for each of your buildings that has a card on it.

starter.name: Barn
starter.abilityText: Hand size 5. When you build a SHED, Draw 1.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Barn
upgraded.abilityText: Hand size 7. When you build a SHED, Draw 1.

starter.name: Farmstead
starter.abilityText:
When you Build, put 1 card you spend from your hand into your barn instead of discarding it.
Flips free when you have 3 Dairy buildings.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Farmstead
upgraded.abilityText: When you Build, put up to 2 cards you spend from your hand into your barn instead of discarding them.

starter.name: Notice Board
starter.abilityText:
VISITOR: Take £1 from bank
OR Build at a discount of 1. Any crop may pay its crop costs.

catalogue.name: The Milking Shed
catalogue.abilityText: Build at a discount of 1.

catalogue.name: The Churning Shed
catalogue.abilityText: Build. SOW the cards you spend onto the new building.

catalogue.name: The Trading Shed
catalogue.abilityText: Build. Give 1 card you spend to a neighbour and take £1 from the bank.

catalogue.name: The Versatile Shed
catalogue.abilityText: Build. You may spend cards from one of your buildings as well as from your hand.

catalogue.name: The Abundant Shed
catalogue.abilityText: Build. Draw 1.

catalogue.name: The Prosperity Wagon
catalogue.abilityText: Build at a discount of 1 for each different crop among the buildings you have built.

catalogue.name: The Scout's Post
catalogue.abilityText: Reveal the top card of each deck. You may build 1 of them at a discount of 2.

catalogue.name: The Heritage House
catalogue.abilityText: Build on top of one of your buildings (never a starter). Put every card on the covered building into your barn. The covered card scores its VP at game end.

catalogue.name: The Butter Factory
catalogue.abilityText: Build 2 buildings.

catalogue.name: The Cheese Vault
catalogue.abilityText: Draw a card for every building you have built. Give any cards over your hand limit to other players, and take £1 from the bank for each.

catalogue.name: The Cream Refinery
catalogue.abilityText: Put one of your buildings, and every card on it, into your barn. Then put the top card of any deck into your barn for each card in its build cost.

catalogue.name: The Grand Creamery
catalogue.abilityText: Reveal deck tops one at a time and build each one free. Each must cost more than the last, or it is discarded and you stop.

catalogue.name: The Ledger
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever you Build, Draw 1. Once per turn.

catalogue.name: The Strongbox
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever a neighbour Builds, take £1 from the bank.

catalogue.name: Helping Hand
catalogue.abilityText: When you VISIT a neighbour, you may place a second card on their Notice Board and take its action again.

catalogue.name: The Cheese Hall
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 1 VP for each non-Dairy building you have built.

catalogue.name: The Counting House
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 1 VP for every 2 buildings you have built.

catalogue.name: The Refinery
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 2 VP for each of your starters showing its upgraded side.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Barn
upgraded.abilityText: Hand size 7. When you build an ORCHARD, Draw 2.

starter.name: Farmstead
starter.abilityText:
Your Draw is Draw 3, discard 1. Give the discarded card to a neighbour.
Flips free when you have 3 Orchard buildings.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Farmstead
upgraded.abilityText: Your Draw is Draw 3, discard 1. Give the discarded card to a neighbour and take £1 from the bank.

starter.name: Notice Board
starter.abilityText:
VISITOR: Take £1 from bank
OR Draw 2.

catalogue.name: The Apple Orchard
catalogue.abilityText: Draw 2.

catalogue.name: The Pear Orchard
catalogue.abilityText: Draw 2, then SOW 1 card from your hand onto this ORCHARD.

catalogue.name: The Cherry Orchard
catalogue.abilityText: Draw 2, then give 1 card from your hand to a neighbour and take £1 from the bank.

catalogue.name: The Golden Orchard
catalogue.abilityText: Draw 2, then you may Harvest one of your ORCHARDs.

catalogue.name: The Heritage Orchard
catalogue.abilityText: Draw 2, then you may Build.

catalogue.name: The Fruit Stand
catalogue.abilityText: Give any number of cards from your hand to your neighbours, one each. Draw 2 for each.

catalogue.name: The Cider House
catalogue.abilityText: SOW 1 card from your hand onto each of your ORCHARDs.

catalogue.name: The Harvest Market
catalogue.abilityText: Harvest this ORCHARD, however many cards are on it, then Draw 1 for each card harvested.

catalogue.name: The Fruit Press
catalogue.abilityText: Put any number of cards from your hand into your barn.

catalogue.name: The Grand Orchard
catalogue.abilityText: GROW each of your ORCHARDs in turn, paying each cost as you go. Skip any you cannot or do not want to pay.

catalogue.name: The Conservatory
catalogue.abilityText: SOW every card in your hand onto your buildings, then draw until your hand is full.

catalogue.name: The Garden Library
catalogue.abilityText: Take the top card of each deck. Give 1 to each other player, keep the rest, and take £1 from the bank for each card given.

catalogue.name: The Orchard Keeper
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever you VISIT a neighbour, Draw 1.

catalogue.name: The Fruit Basket
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever you discard a card, you may pay £1 to put it into your barn instead.

catalogue.name: Helping Hand
catalogue.abilityText: When you VISIT a neighbour, you may place a second card on their Notice Board and take its action again.

catalogue.name: The Fruit Hall
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 1 VP for each empty space in your hand.

catalogue.name: The Orchard Archive
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 2 VP for each ORCHARD you have built.

catalogue.name: The Harvest Festival
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 1 VP for every 2 cards in other players' hands.

starter.name: Barn
starter.abilityText: Hand size 5. When you build a DEPOT, Draw 2.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Barn
upgraded.abilityText: Hand size 7. When you build a DEPOT, Draw 2.

starter.name: Farmstead
starter.abilityText:
When you Deliver to the island, you may first put 1 card from your hand into your barn.
Flips free when you have 3 Vegetable buildings.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Farmstead
upgraded.abilityText: When you Deliver to the island, you may first put up to 2 cards from your hand into your barn, and you may swap 1 card in your barn for the top card of any deck.

starter.name: Notice Board
starter.abilityText:
VISITOR: Take £1 from bank
OR You may put 1 card from your hand into your barn, then Deliver.

catalogue.name: The Market Stall Depot
catalogue.abilityText: Discard 1 card to move a Balloon to your Aerodrome and take its reward.

catalogue.name: The Coastal Trading Depot
catalogue.abilityText: You may swap two demand tokens on the island, then Deliver.

catalogue.name: The Trade Depot
catalogue.abilityText: Turn face down a demand token on a tile where a receipt has already been taken, then Deliver.

catalogue.name: The Export Depot
catalogue.abilityText: Harvest one of your buildings, then Deliver.

catalogue.name: The Regional Depot
catalogue.abilityText: Discard 1 card to move a Balloon to your Aerodrome and take the reward of any Balloon.

catalogue.name: The Merchant Guild
catalogue.abilityText: Draw 2, then put 1 card from your hand into your barn.

catalogue.name: The Supply House
catalogue.abilityText: Draw 1 for each receipt you have taken.

catalogue.name: The Market Master
catalogue.abilityText: SOW up to 1 card from your hand onto your buildings for each card in your barn.

catalogue.name: The Auction House
catalogue.abilityText: Put up to 1 card from your hand into your barn for each DEPOT you have built.

catalogue.name: The Grand Marketplace
catalogue.abilityText: For each different crop in your barn, put the top card of that crop's deck into your barn.

catalogue.name: The Distribution Center
catalogue.abilityText: Deliver to a tile where nobody has delivered, and take both of its receipts.

catalogue.name: The International Port
catalogue.abilityText: Put the top card of any deck into each other player's barn, Draw 1 for each, then Deliver.

catalogue.name: The Market Signal Tower
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever a neighbour moves a Balloon from your Aerodrome, take £2.

catalogue.name: The Dockworker's Union
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever you move a Balloon, Draw 1.

catalogue.name: Helping Hand
catalogue.abilityText: When you VISIT a neighbour, you may place a second card on their Notice Board and take its action again.

catalogue.name: The Market Gazette
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 2 VP for each Balloon at your Aerodrome.

catalogue.name: The Trading Commission
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 2 VP for each DEPOT you have built.

catalogue.name: The Harvest Ledger
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 1 VP for every 2 cards in your barn.

starter.abilityText: Hand size 5. When you build a FIELD, Draw 2.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Barn
upgraded.abilityText: Hand size 7. When you build a FIELD, Draw 2.

starter.name: Farmstead
starter.abilityText:
Harvest: Any card with 2+ cards on it, even if not full.
Flips free when you have 3 Wheat buildings.

upgraded.name: Upgraded Farmstead
upgraded.abilityText:
Harvest: Any card with 2+ cards on it, even if not full.
Harvest is 2 buildings.

starter.name: Notice Board
starter.abilityText:
VISITOR: Take £1 from bank
OR Harvest, then you may put 1 card from your hand into your barn.

catalogue.name: Wheat Field
catalogue.abilityText:
Draw 1.
HARVEST: Put 1 card from your hand into your barn. Sow 1 FIELD from the deck.

catalogue.name: Rye Field
catalogue.abilityText:
Draw 1.
HARVEST: Draw 2. Sow 1 FIELD from the deck.

catalogue.name: Barley Field
catalogue.abilityText:
Draw 1.
HARVEST: Sow 1 card from your hand onto each of your FIELDs. Sow 1 FIELD from the deck.

catalogue.name: Golden Field
catalogue.abilityText:
Draw 1, then sow the top card of any deck onto this FIELD.
HARVEST: Build, at a discount of 1. Sow 1 FIELD from the deck.

catalogue.name: Heritage Field
catalogue.abilityText:
Draw 1, then put 1 card from your hand into your barn.
HARVEST: Harvest another of your buildings. Sow 1 FIELD from the deck.

catalogue.name: Mill House
catalogue.abilityText: Sow the top card of any deck onto each of your FIELDs.

catalogue.name: The Furrow
catalogue.abilityText: Put your entire hand into your barn.

catalogue.name: The Bakehouse
catalogue.abilityText: Harvest one of your buildings, however many cards are on it, then Deliver.

catalogue.name: Crop Rotation
catalogue.abilityText: Harvest every FIELD with 1 or more cards on it.

catalogue.name: The Bakery
catalogue.abilityText: Harvest every one of your buildings, however many cards are on them.

catalogue.name: The Pizzeria
catalogue.abilityText: Every other player may Draw 1. Gain £1 for each card drawn.

catalogue.name: The Patisserie
catalogue.abilityText: Put the top card of each deck into your barn.

catalogue.name: The Granary
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever you harvest, Draw 1.

catalogue.name: The Pie Shop
catalogue.abilityText: Whenever a neighbour places a card on one of your buildings, gain £1.

catalogue.name: Helping Hand
catalogue.abilityText: When you use a neighbour's Service, you may place a second card on it to use it again.

catalogue.name: The Wheat Exchange
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 2 VP for each different crop among the buildings you have built.

catalogue.name: The Grand Granary
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 1 VP for each building you have built.

catalogue.name: The Bread Hall
catalogue.abilityText: Game end: 2 VP for each FIELD you have built.
